text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Air Shakur said he wasn't feeling 
well, I escorted him to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going to sleep. Just leave me alone 
already.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Where is this—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit, it won't open... Am I locked in?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't underestimate me. A simple 
electronic key like this is nothing for—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text: Fuhahahaha! Splendid, Air Shakur-kun!!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text:
Your super-hacker skills are just as 
impressive as the rumors say! Allow me to 
welcome you once again. Welcome to—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text: To our 'Sweet Carrot Haters Brigade'!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ......Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text:
We have been searching all along! For an 
ally in our brigade's noble mission: 
Operation Eradicate Glacé Carrots!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text:
Now, use your hacking skills right away to 
delete glazed carrot recipes from every 
recipe site across the entire world, if 
you please!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What kind of headache-inducing plan is 
that? I ain't got the free time to help 
with crap like that.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text: WHAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text:
To disagree with our noble ideals... You 
must be a Glacé supremacist, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Man
text_block_list.text:
Argh! We cannot let these glacé loyalists 
run rampant any longer! To arms, everyone, 
to arms!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it, this makes no damn sense!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. With this, we've seized control 
of the building. Elevators halted, 
emergency doors sealed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That oughta buy us a little time. Even 
so――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I had no clue what was going 
on... I mean, really.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why am I running away like it's for real, 
anyway? If you think about it logically, 
something like this is obviously—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ......See, it really was a dream.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, what's with that name...? "The 
Sweet Carrot Haters Squad"...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. That was so silly it took the 
wind right out of me. Guess I'll get up 
and grab something to eat."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She seemed seriously dangerous... I gotta 
get outta this building before she spots 
me.

text_block_list.name: Reluctant Group Members
text_block_list.text: There she is, don't let her get away!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Shakur became a hunted 
fugitive. Will the day ever come when he 
can thwart the ambitions of the 
"Anti-Sweet Carrot Brigade"—?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Wait, as if that's even possible!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, that dream was so stupid it just 
made me more tired... I should've just 
rested in my own room...
